newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Strategic still sees higher FFO.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Strategic still sees higher FFO.

text.p: Banyan Strategic Realty Trust said it continues to see funds from operation (FFO) in 1997 of between $0.50 and $0.55 a share.
Its FFO target for 1998 remains $0.65 to $0.70 a share. The company had made these projections for 1997 and 1998 in April. FFO in 1996 was $0.34 a share.
In a statement issued Monday, Banyan reported first quarter FFO of $0.10 a share, up from $0.09 a year ago.

The company also announced the purchase of the Butterfield Office Plaza, located 20 miles west of Chicago in DuPage County, for $14.9 million. The property, which consists of a three-story office building on 10 acres, is 92 percent leased with 50 tenants, it added.
